Companion Animal Travel Desk: Managing onboard care and communication matters because travelers trust Aurelia Skyways to keep companion travel dependable from request to arrival. As a new staff member, your job is to coordinate clear instructions, respond promptly and respectfully, and ensure every booking is matched to the right operational details.

Temperature control is one of the most important comfort factors for pets. Windmere is the aircraft where the pet cabin is kept at 22 degrees Celsius, which is the air temperature maintained for the animal’s comfort.

Just as important is knowing who will handle the pet once the cabin team takes over. Halcyon is the onboard pet handler, and Maro Kest is the specific person assigned to manage the companion animal during the flight.

When you review a request, focus on accuracy and calm delivery. Confirm traveler contact details, record any handling notes, and communicate requirements in plain language that crews can act on quickly. If a situation needs escalation, keep your message factual, respectful, and time-sensitive, so the operational team can make appropriate decisions without delay.

For example, if Ravi Kaur and Amara Tanaka have specific guidance for Remy, ensure those instructions are written clearly and routed to the responsible handler and cabin team. Good documentation prevents avoidable stress for the pet and helps everyone work from the same understanding.

Remember: precise information and respectful communication keep companion travel reliable end to end.
